audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Aurelion Sol the last two stages and called 4-5 and 6 'Skill', while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko on all seven rows. Worse, the full-layer whys underneath those rows already described Neeko winning — phases[5].why said 'root-bloom deletes squishies' under a side that said Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: Neeko is at 59.68% here. Aurelion Sol has no dash, no blink and no shield: his only reposition is Astral Flight at 22s rank 1, his damage is a channel that any root cancels, and his longest offensive reach outside the ultimate is 750 against Neeko's 1000 E. Nothing in the kit supports him taking a lane stage from her.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side = Neeko, with the whys grounded and phases[3].rating raised to match. The whys already argued Neeko's side, so no row now contradicts its own sentence.
sources: enemyKit Q channel flag and range 750

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike story never mentioned the only thing that decides this matchup long-term: Stardust. breakdown.spikes ended on 'Luden's makes the package lethal' with no reference to what he is collecting or why denying it matters.
audit.why: Cosmic Creator says his damaging abilities break enemies down into Stardust, which permanently improves each of his abilities. His power curve is farm, not levels or items — so the Neeko spike that matters is the one that arrives before his stacks do.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now ends 'first-item burst ends an unstacked Sol'; breakdown.carry and breakdown.early reframed around denying channel seconds.
sources: enemyKit Q text (bonus damage improved by Stardust)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (defect 3), and the decisive mechanical fact — that Breath of Light is a channel and any CC cancels it — appeared nowhere on the page in the full layer.
audit.why: His entire damage output and his entire scaling both run through a channel he has to hold on you. Neeko's E roots from 1000 against a 750 channel. That single interaction is why this matchup is 59.68% and it was not stated.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Breath of Light at 3s and interruptible, Singularity at a flat 12s and Falling Star at 120/110/100 from 1250; report[5].t and phases[2].why state the channel break.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 3 and channel flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity's execute threshold and its percent-health damage were both absent from the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: the centre of the black hole executes enemies below a certain point, and it pulls you toward that centre. The feed flags both execute-threshold and resistances-invalidated. Standing in it to finish a trade is the one way Neeko loses this lane, and nothing said so.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2] retitled 'Trade while standing in Singularity' with a body that states the pull, the threshold and the consequence; enemyWin now names the execute and the resistance bypass.
sources: enemyKit E text, execute and percentHealth flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes[1].text calls his level 6 'His Falling Star/Singularity ult' and says 'it's short-range'. Singularity is his E, not his ultimate, and Falling Star reaches 1250 — the longest range in either kit.
audit.why: Two abilities were fused into one name and then given the wrong range. A reader stepping to 900 thinking they are outside his ultimate is inside it. Content 'mid' repeats the same error ('His level 6 Singularity offers a slow and delayed stun, but it's short-range').
audit.corrected: Both rewritten: Falling Star stuns from 1250 and upgrades to The Skies Descend with enough Stardust; Singularity pulls at 750.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content wants.you[1] says 'E-root him during his ult channel'. His ultimate is not a channel; Breath of Light is.
audit.why: The channel flag sits on Q, not R. Rooting 'during his ult' is advice for a thing that does not happen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed on four bullets: dosFull[0].d (title 'Bloom his last-hit contact each cycle') carried the Astral Flight line; dosFull[1].d (title 'Run clone mind-games on every reset') carried tradeGood; dontsFull[2].d carried tradeBad; dontsFull[1].d warned about 'assassin timers' against a champion with no dash and no burst opener.
audit.why: Defect 2, plus a template phrase that is false about this enemy.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to answer their own titles from his kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Placeholder phrasing: dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t said 'his key-spell window' rather than naming a spell (defect 7); dosFull[2].t promised a 'triple-bloom' the kit does not describe.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says the seed blooms again — not three times.
audit.corrected: 'Trade while standing in Singularity' and 'Root the step-up, bloom the rooted target'.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is 'EVEN' at diffRating 5.5/10 on a matchup Neeko wins 59.68% of, with a level chart that gives her all seven stages, and tldr opened 'An even poke war'.
audit.why: The verdict contradicts both the number and the chart. I rewrote the tldr, which is prose, but did not touch diff, tone or diffRating — I do not know which token the renderer accepts for a favoured matchup and guessing an invalid enum would be worse than leaving it.
audit.corrected: tldr and winCon reframed around denial rather than an even poke war. diff / tone / diffRating / breakdown.difficulty left alone pending the answer in questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood claimed 'the full package is half a bar at level 3' — magnitude with no source (defect 6).
audit.why: No damage figures in the kits. The real exit cue is his channel restarting.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the sequence plus 'walk before Breath of Light restarts'.
